info.title: InsureTech API
info.description: This is the Dream Payments InsureTech API reference site, which contains a full index of API and how to integrate with it. Every call must include an access token. All responses are shown in JSON.

post.description:
This API allows operations users the ability to add new payee primary users and payee profiles to the platform, enabling that payee user to start the registration process (for managed users).

The personal information that is provided includes mandatory name, and optional email, mobile number and language preference. The payee information provided includes mandatory account name, address and optional customer number.

If the user email address is present, the platform validates if it has already been used within the platform. If another user has already used the email within the platform, then the API responds with an appropriate error response to the caller.

If the user email address is not present, the user created will not be able to log into the Merchant Portal and will not receive email notifications from the platform.

On successful completion of this API, a managed user has a status of EMAIL_SENT and an unmanaged user has a status of ACTIVE. The payee profile status is ACTIVE, and the withdrawal service is enabled for the payee. That service is not added/enabled for the payee user until registration is successfully completed.

**_Errors_**
- Authorization error.
- Invalid argument.
- Duplicate email.
- Invalid phone.
- Duplicate customer/business number.

_Note_: All errors are accompanied by error code and error text.

This API allows operations users to deactivate active payee accounts. Once deactivated, the payee will continue to receive any outstanding payments that have already been accepted, but no new payments can be submitted for the payee, and no further payments can be aceepted by users.

Associated payee users can continue to log into the system and view their history until the payee and user are moved to a deleted status. This occurs after a configurable period of time elapses.

**_INTERNAL - NOT EXPOSED_**

This API provides the means to determine which payee transition scenarios that can be actioned are available for the calling operations user, based on the roles that user fulfills, and on the status of the payee being managed.

The calling application may use this information to present the available scenarios as actions that can be performed. On selection of an action, the application calls API ApplyPayeeTransition to initiate the action. This capabilities API reply may also contain note templates that the operations user may select from to provide additional details relating to the action as a note attached to the business profile. It also includes an indicator specifying whether or not a user note need be submitted for the subsequent handle scenario API.

This API allows operations users to resend an email containing an authentication link to the payee user’s email address. On receipt, the user validates that the email address is correct by clicking on the link.

Some use cases demonstrating how this API can be used are
- To resend a "claim funds" email, set the `objectId` argument to the payment ID and the `verificationCode` argument to CUSTOMER_PROFILE.
- To resend a "change email" email, set the `objectId` argument to the new email address and the `verificationCode` argument to CUSTOMER_EMAILS.

- Invalid argument.
- Invalid payee user ID.

This API allows callers to accept or re-accept a payment. On accepting a payment, the caller indicates what account the payment should be applied to. Re-acceptance is a way that a caller can change the account assignment, if required.

Each of the elements involved in the action must have an appropriate status for acceptance, and all elements must be properly associated through a common payee.

On successful completion, the system performs a funds transfer for the payment through the payment method or rail that the caller selected. Examples of payment methods include EFT and Mastercard Send.

- Invalid argument.
- Account not associated.
- Invalid customer ID.
- Invalid payment ID.
- Invalid bank account ID.
- Invalid customer status.
- Invalid payment status.
- Invalid bank account status.
- Invalid payment method.

Note: All errors must be accompanied by error code and error text.

This API allows an integrating partner to submit a payment for a primary payee and one or more additional payees to the Dream Payments Platform. Only the primary payee user will be notified of the payment with an email that solicits acceptance of the payment. If the primary payee user has an EMAIL_SENT status, the payment notification also acts as the email authentication link as well.

Additional payees may have profiles in the platform, in which case they are referenced by identifier in the request structure. If an additional payee does not have a profile, then the request contains the payee and payee user information associated with the payee.

Additional payees with profiles are actors in the payment lifecycle, where the part they fulfill is identified by the `action` request argument field. Actions can reflect primary approver, secondary approver, observer or beneficiary.

The beneficiary, if specified, must match the primary payee user. If not specified, a benficiary will be automatically added to match the primary payee user.

The primary payee user and payee must be appropriately associated.

The `checkRecipientName` and `checkRecipientAddress` fields are used in conjunction with a valid immediate allowable payment method (i.e. `MPCPSI` and `MPCPSCI`).

**_Errors_**
- Authorization error.
- Invalid argument.
- Invalid payee user ID.
- Invalid payee ID.
- Invalid payee user status.
- Invalid payee status.
- Invalid payment type.
- Invalid payment method.
- Account not associated.
- Duplicate draft number.
- No additional or review payees.
- Missing account name for additional payee.
- Missing first name for additional payee.
- Missing last name for additional payee.
- Missing profile indicator value for additional payee.
- Missing preffered language for additional payee.
- Missing mustBePresent value for additional payee.
- Too many additional payees.
- Check name too long.
- Too many review payees.
- Invalid review payee action.
- Too many beneficiaries.
- Mismatched beneficiary.
- No primary reviewers.

_Note_: All errors are accompanied by error code and error text.

For Checks (i.e. SPC and SP), programmatic stop requests are accepted but not processed by the JPM host. Also, for the Interac eTransfer rail (i.e. ETRAN) stop requests cannot be programatically invoked. Therefore, stopping such payments involves making a manual stop request through the JPM Access Portal and reporting the results back through this API. Results are either success or failure.

post.description:
This API enables any software platform to send attachment links of files (with file name) stored on their servers. Few other information such as file format type, file size also should be provided along with attachment file link.

**_Errors_**

- Authorization error.
- Invalid or empty file name (file name must only contain alphanumeric, period, hyphen, underscore, or space characters. No period, hyphen, underscore, or space characters allowed at start or end of file name)
- Invalid file type (if not pdf, jpeg, png, doc,docx, zip)
- File unit must be in Bytes
- File storage service unavailable
- Connection timeout to upload attachment
- Invalid file URL (file URL must only contain alphanumeric, forward slash, back slash, period, hyphen, underscore, or space characters. No period, hyphen, underscore, or space characters allowed at start or end of file URL. No forward slash or back slash allowed at end of file URL)
- File size can not exceed 15 numbers (in bytes)

_Note_: All errors are accompanied by error code and error text.

Meta data for the attached file can contain information such as file format type, file size, uploaded date, uploaded by, tenant Id (tenant Id will be generated by the insuretech system admin) etc.

This API implements the following validation prior to accepting the file attachment:

File Format Validation: The attachment file must have the following file format.

.pdf
.jpeg
.jpg
.csv
File Size Validation: The attachment file must be of the following size.

Greater than 0 Kb
Less than 4,000 Kb

**_Errors_**

- Authorization error.
- Invalid or empty file name
- File size can not exceed 4000 kb

This API allows callers to associate external bank or card account information with the payee profile and to initiates the account verification process.

On successful completion, the account information is associated with the payee. The account may be automatically verified, or it may require verification. To verify the account, the service initiates a request to the partner bank to make a deposit into the account of a small, randomly generated amount. The deposit amount acts as a verification code. Debit card data is currently automatically verified.

To request the deposit of the verification amount, the API creates an order record for the deposit.

After the payee user has a record of the deposit amount in the account being registered, he/she verifies the account by entering the appropriate code in the account verification page.

Accounts may only be added to a payee when all other accounts for the payee of the same generic account type (i.e. BANK or CARD) have status of DELETED, CANCELLED, DEACTIVATED, or PENDING_DEACTIVATED (i.e. no pending or active accounts).

When added, an account starts with status NEW. If automatically verified, then the account becomes ACTIVE immediately. If verification is required, then the account assumes an IN_PROGRESS status when the bank partner deposit request is made. If the deposit request has a successful response (signifying successful submission only), then the account goes to a NOT_VERIFIED status. If the deposit response signifies failure, the account goes to a FAILED or a REQUIRES_ATTENTION status. A REQUIRES_ATTENTION status signifies a system problem that requires system administrator attention to resolve.

**_Errors_**
- Authorization error.
- Invalid argument.
- Invalid payee user ID.
- Invalid payee ID.
- Account not associated.
- Invalid institution number.
- Invalid branch number.
- Bank branch closed.
- Branch does not belong to institution.
- Invalid service account status.

_Note_: All errors are accompanied by error code and error text.

get.description:
This API allows operations users to retrieve the list of bank accounts associated with the specified payee. It includes all bank accounts, including cancelled and deactivated accounts.

There may be multiple bank accounts associated with a payee, but at most one will be verified and ACTIVE, and one will be unverified (status of IN_PROGRESS, REQUIRES_ATTENTION, FAILED or NOT_VERIFIED). All other associated bank accounts will be DELETED, CANCELLED, PENDING_DEACTIVATED, or DEACTIVATED.

_Note_: The reply bank account number field contains masked account number only.

**_Errors_**
- Authorization error.
- Invalid payee ID.

_Note_: All errors are accompanied by error code and error text.

This service can only be called for an account that has a FAILED, REQUIRES_ATTENTION, NOT_VERIFIED, SUSPENDED or ACTIVE status.

On successful completion of this service, the account verification process is initiated once again.

post.summary: Restore Suspended Bank Account for Payee
post.description:
**_INTERNAL - NOT EXPOSED_**

This API allows operations users to restore the specified bank account from a SUSPENDED status back to an ACTIVE status; no other transition scenarios should be supported. The passed PayeeId should be validated to actually own the BankAccountId.

If the payee has any payments in a FAILED status, this API will mark them ACCEPTED once again so that the payment may be attempted now that the bank account is active.

**_Errors_**
- Authorization error.
- Invalid argument.
- Invalid payee ID. 
- Invalid bank account ID.
- Invalid bank account.
- Invalid bank account status.
- Account not associated.

_Note_: All errors are accompanied by error code and error text.

This API allows a caller to verify a pending bank or card account for the payee. The verification code is the amount that was deposited into the account when the account was added.

If the validation signifies that the verification code is incorrect, the service return with an appropriate error code and message. If the validation signifies that the verification code is correct, then the service performs a number of operations.

If the just verified account was added as part of the add bank account process (i.e. it is not linked to an already active account), then the account assumes an ACTIVE status.

If, on successful validation, the just verified account is linked to an already active account (i.e. an account added as part of the change bank account process), then the pending account is replacing the current one. In this case, the existing active account takes on a DEACTIVATED status, and the pending account takes on an ACTIVE status.

This service can only be invoked against a pending account in NOT_VERIFIED status.

**_Errors_**
- Authorization error.
- Invalid argument.
- Invalid token.
- Invalid bank account ID.
- Invalid bank account status.
- Invalid verification code.

Note: All errors must be accompanied by error code and error text.

Assigns custom registration questions to a user. The user will be prompted to answer all or a subset of these questions provided the custom challenges feature is enabled.

**_Errors_**
* Unable to connect to DynamoDB. **[RVS0001]**
* Could not save identity challenge. **[RVS0002]**
* Could not read request. **[RVS0003]**
* Could not retrieve challenges for user. **[RVS0004]**
* Could not set custom challenges. **[RVS0005]**
* Could not read the challenges record retrieved from the database. **[RVS0006]**
* The index for each question must be unique across the challenge set. **[RVS0007]**
* UserId could not be read from the request. **[RVS0008]**
* No custom challenges could not be read from the request. **[RVS0009]**
* Too many custom challenges in the request. **[RVS0010]**
* index field is mandatory for each custom challenge. **[RVS0011]**
* question field is mandatory for each custom challenge. **[RVS0012]**
* answer field is mandatory for each custom challenge. **[RVS0013]**
* question field is too long. **[RVS0014]**
* answer field is too long. **[RVS0015]**
* index field is too long. **[RVS0016]**
- Internal server error. **[G00002]**

index.description:
The challenge index. This can have any string value, but it needs to be unique when compared to any other indexes in the request.

This means:
- You cannot have two questions with the same index.
- You can reuse an index for different users.
- If you send multiple requests for the same user, but you reuse an index, you will overwrite the question with that index.

userId.description: The user identifier for which the custom challenges will be used during registration.

requestBody.description: The challenges being added and the user they are being added to.

bankAccountId.description: This field need not be set for payment methods CPx, DCPx, MPCPx, JPM_ETRAN and SUA. For other payment methods it is required.

paymentMethod.description: The payment method to use for sending the payment.

AdditionalPayee.title: AdditionalPayee
AdditionalPayee.description: Additional payee and payee user information. If profiles exist in the platform the identifier fields are used to reference those profiles. Otherwise the account information structures are used to capture the relevant details.

action.description: The action provided by the payment added payee.

mustBePresent.description: Indicator identifying if additional party should be mandatory or optional as a recipient.

AdditionalPayeeAccountInfo.title: AdditionalPayeeAccountInfo
AdditionalPayeeAccountInfo.description: Account information related to the payment participant payee, when that payee has no profile in the platform.

accountName.description: The account holder name for the payee bank account.

AdditionalPayeeUserAccountInfo.title: AdditionalPayeeUserAccountInfo
AdditionalPayeeUserAccountInfo.description: Account information related to the payment participant payee user, when that payee has no profile in the platform.

contactName.description: The payee user contact name data structure.

managed.description: Indicator identifying if the payee user is managed by the platform.

AddPaymentReply.title: AddPaymentReply
AddPaymentReply.description: Payment information returned on creation of a payment.

legalEntityLabel.description: When adding a payment, if legalEntity field is omitted then this field must be set.

allowablePaymentMethods.description: This identifies the payment methods allowed for a payment.

checkRecipientName.description:
Name for a cheque payment postal mail recipient.

**Note**: If either recipient name or address is specified, then both must be.

currencyCode.description: The currency code of the payment amount.

value.description: The payment amount value in cents.

emails.description: Email objects associated with the customer.

phones.description: Phone objects associated with the customer.

managed.description: An identifier signifying if the user is managed by the platform. If not set, the default is true.

allowablePaymentMethods.description: This identifies the allowed payment methods for a payment.

checkRecipientAddress.description: Address of postal mail recipient of cheque, when different from the payee.

checkRecipientName.description: Name of postal mail recipient of cheque, when different from the payee.

shippingMethod.description: The concatenation of the Shipping Carrier and Shipping Service Name.

draftNumber.description: The payment draft number, used as a unique payment identifier.

externalReferenceData.description: External payment reference data. This can contain anything relevant to the caller.

legalEntity.description: When adding a payment, this field may be omitted if identifying legal entity by label. Otherwise it is required.

memo.description: The payment memo, included in payment detail views.

payoutDate.description: The date desired for payout of the payment to the payee.

pcoNumber.description: The payment PCO number. If applicable, this is associated with the payment legal entity.

policyNumber.description: The policy number this payment is associated with.

checkNumber.description: The check number for the payment, if applicable.

paymentReceivedDate.description: The date the payee received the payment.

attachmentIds.description: A list of attachement identifiers for attachments associated with the payment.

RecipientAddress.title: RecipientAddress
RecipientAddress.description: Address for a payment postal mail recipient. This address is not associated with a profile in our system.

address2.description: A secondary streety address line (e.g. Suite or apartment number).

countryCode.description: The address country code (2 character ISO code).

postalOrZipCode.description: The address postal or zip code.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Review information for one or more maker/checker review items that are being or have been reviewed.

reviewType.description: The review type identifier. Reviews of a specific type are independent of reviews of other types, even for the same review item.

reviewObjectId.description: The identifier of the object being reviewed.

primaryReviewItems.description: The list of primary approver review items associated with the review. At least one primary approver is required.

secondaryReviewItems.description: The list of secondary approver review items associated with the review. These reviews follow approval by all primary approvers.

cancellerId.description: The identifier of the user that cancelled the review, if applicable.

queuedTimestamp.description: The timestamp the review was created.

finalTimestamp.description: The timestamp the overall review was approved, rejected or cancelled.

ReviewItem.title: ReviewItem
ReviewItem.description: Information about a maker/checker review item that is being or has been reviewed.

payeeId.description: The identifier of the payee associated with the approval review.

payeeUserId.description: The identifier of the payee user assigned to perform an approval review for this payment.

accountName.description: The account name associated with the payee profile.

checkerNote.description: Information provided by the checker. This value is required for rejected review items and will only be set once the review item is either approved or rejected.

finalTimestamp.description: The timestamp the item was approved, rejected or cancelled.

ReviewPayee.title: ReviewPayee
ReviewPayee.description: Information related toa payee that participates in a digital multiparty review for a payment.

action.description: The action performed by the payment review participant.

Status.title: Status
Status.description: The result of an API action.

errorMessage.description: A descriptive error or return message.
